note: Australia issues no national identity card: the Commonwealth's identity document is the passport, and the others, such as driver licences, are issued by the states and territories; the national Digital ID is not a card, a number or a new form of ID (the Minister for Finance, 2023).

sources.title: Senator the Hon Katy Gallagher, Minister for Finance, speech: Digital ID and AI insights (2023)
sources.said: Importantly, Digital ID is not a card, it' not a unique number, nor a new form of ID. ... the Commonwealth can only verify people biometrically against their passports, not against their driver licence or other ID documents issued by state and territory governments.
